citation: Jurkovic et al. (2022), Type II and anomalous Cepheids in the Kepler K2 mission, MNRAS 518, 642-663, Appendix A Table A1
method_summary: Cosine Fourier series; R_i1=A_i/A_1 and phi_i1=phi_i-i*phi_1; OGLE-III and OGLE-IV V-band observations could be merged; objects with fewer than 50 measurements were excluded; uncertainties were estimated from 100 resamples containing 60 percent of the measurements.
source_scope: Published external analysis of an OGLE V-band light curve that may merge OGLE-III and OGLE-IV observations; exact source bytes and row membership were not supplied in the article table.
